paper_title: Single-nucleus profiling of human dilated and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
notes: Dataset01 includes DCM, HCM, and non-failing controls. Author Lymphatic_endothelial annotation can be used as a reference check, not as final LEC definition.

Dataset08 contains human single-nucleus RNA-seq data with DoxCM, NICM, and donor control groups. The group column was standardized to disease labels: Donor -> NF, DoxCM -> DoxCM, NICM -> NICM. RNA counts, not SCT values, should be used for count-based QC and marker expression analysis.

Preview showed 48,866 nuclei, 36,601 genes, 28,761 control cells, 20,105 HFpEF cells, and 433 author-labeled Lymphatic_endothelial cells. raw_count_cellbender is used as the counts layer when available.

disease_states: NF; DCM; HF; ACM; CAV; RCM_LVNC
notes: Age metadata includes Age, Age_range, Age_range_normalized, sex, Disease, Heart_failure, LVEF, cell_type, broad.cell.type, sub.cluster, sample, and Donor. All final LEC-rule markers are present in the 5000-feature object.
